annotations.title: Open sales roles by kind and company

description: The count of sales roles open today and of those posted over the past 7 days, split by kind of sales work and by hiring company (each with the slug search_sales_jobs takes). Pass a country to count only the roles open to people there. Use it to size the sales job market, to see who is hiring most, or to find a company's slug before calling search_sales_jobs with platform. For the roles themselves use search_sales_jobs, and for pay use get_sales_pay.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code (for example 'US' or 'DE'); counts only the roles open to people in that country.
